about: Reviewed Sri Lankan (+94) phone-number SHAPE metadata extracted from a pinned libphonenumber-js metadata artifact. Shape classification only — not a verification that a number is allocated, reachable or the sender's. No operator attribution (number portability).

provenance.upstream: Google libphonenumber metadata (Apache-2.0), packaged by libphonenumber-js (MIT)
provenance.reviewedBy: M4 workspace source review (Lead-run, 15 November 2026); owner acceptance pending

limits: Classifies number SHAPE from reviewed metadata. It never proves the number is allocated, reachable, subscribed, or belongs to the sender.
No operator attribution is produced: mobile number portability means a prefix does not identify the current operator.
Only Sri Lankan (+94) numbers are normalised; other country codes are reported as unclassified, never invalid or safe.

Refresh procedure: download the pinned libphonenumber-js metadata version, verify the recorded SHA-256, extract the LK entry, update this file and re-run node code/preprocess/scripts/generate-lk-phone-metadata.ts. Version or hash movement is a reviewed decision, not a silent update.
No network access is performed at runtime or by the generator; this file is the reviewed, vendored source.
